task: Repair the source-free ABI-v9 generic raise/recover control without exposing its private error enum.
observation: The outward function effect set is correctly empty because the local try/recover consumes Failure.Bad, so it cannot tell the ABI writer which private enum the generic body needs. The checker does retain the exact raised identity on the Raise statement's exceptional_alternatives. Serializing that checker-owned identity's closed private enum metadata lets the source-free v9 checker type the body while module_export_names still keeps Failure private.
impact: The existing v9 failure was earlier than native lowering: the imported generic body could not type Failure.Bad and emitted RAISE_REQUIRES_TYPED_VALUE. The new v9 oracle passes source-backed and source-deleted Debug/Release; a rehashed forged declaration ID is rejected by the bound provider/library contract before projection.

resolution.summary: ABI-v9 metadata now carries checker-observed private raised enum identity and variants without adding the declaration to public exports.
